  print('q7.conjugate() = ${q7.conjugate}');

  print('q8 = $q8'); 
  print('norm(q8) = ${q8.norm}');

  print('q1 * q3 = $q1 * $q3 = ${q1 * q3}'); 
  print('q2 * q3 = $q2 * $q3 = ${q2 * q3}'); 

  final q9 = Quaternion(0, 0, 0, 0);

class Quaternion {
  
  final double x, y, z, w;

  const Quaternion(
    this.x, 
    this.y, 
    this.z, 
    this.w,
  );

  double get norm => sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z + w * w);

  Quaternion conjugate() =>
      Quaternion(x, -y, -z, w);

  Quaternion normalized() =>
      Quaternion(x / norm, y / norm, z / norm, w / norm);

  bool get isZero => x == 0 && y == 0 && z == 0 && w == 0;

  static Quaternion fromEuler(
    double roll,
    double pitch,
    double yaw,
  ) {
    final s = sin(roll / 2);
    final c = cos(roll / 2);
    final p = sin(pitch / 2);
    final q = cos(pitch / 2);
    final y = sin(yaw / 2);
    final q2 = cos(yaw / 2);
    return Quaternion(
      c * q * q2 + s * p * y,
      s * q * q2 - c * p * y,
      p * q2 * y,
      c * q2,
    );
  }

  static Quaternion rotate(
    this Quaternion,

    double centerX,

    final axis = axisIndex < 3 ? axisIndex : 3 - axisIndex;

    final s = sin(theta / 2);
